explication: OpenComic is an Electron comic and manga reader. Users open local or remote libraries, browse and organize files, then read images or ebooks with configurable viewing modes and resume progress; OPDS catalogs and reading trackers extend that workflow. The graph combines documented capabilities with relationships visible in the excerpts or SOURCE INDEX. Many feature modules are unsampled, so their documented branches are shown without guessed call edges.
